Effective line: The afterlife is processing again. Agnes says the queue moved four whole numbers yesterday. We had cake.
Suggested line: The afterlife is processing again. Agnes says the queue moved four whole numbers yesterday, so we had cake.

Effective line: I have a new stamp. It says HELPED. I have used it nine times. I am counting.
Suggested line: I've got a new stamp that says HELPED. I've used it nine times so far, and yes, I'm counting.

Effective line: You may challenge me again, if you like. No permit required. That one is my favourite rule.
Suggested line: You can challenge me again if you like, and you won't need a permit to do it. That's my favourite rule. I wrote it myself.

Effective line: The barrier is down. A sign with a stamp on it says the road needs a permit. Nobody has ever been issued one.
Suggested line: The barrier is down, and a stamped sign beside it says the road needs a permit. Nobody has ever been issued one.

Effective line: Halt. This checkpoint requires a permit. Permits are not issued. Please take a number.
Suggested line: Halt. Passage through this checkpoint requires a permit, and no permit has ever been issued. Please take a number.

Effective line: Your number is zero. It is always zero. Now serving: nobody.
Suggested line: Your number is zero, as is everyone's. This checkpoint is now serving nobody, and will continue to do so.

Effective line: The authorization is valid. Policy says I must stop you. I have read all of the policy. Twice.
Suggested line: The authorization is valid, and policy states that I must stop you. I have read all of the policy, twice.

Effective line: Your number is zero. It is always zero. Please hold.
Suggested line: Your number is zero, as it always is. Please hold.

Effective line: APPROVED. ...That was the wrong stamp. That felt... nice. Disregard.
Suggested line: APPROVED. ...That was the wrong stamp, and it felt... nice. Disregard that.

Effective line: ...I can hear my own thoughts again. I think I was Pending for a decade. Old habits die hard. Unlike me.
Suggested line: ...I can hear my own thoughts again. I think I've been Pending for ten years. It was very quiet in there, and very orderly, and none of it was me.

Effective line: {villain} did not corrupt us. He used our own rules: a perfectly valid transfer of authority, notarized and filed.
Suggested line: {villain} didn't need to corrupt us. He used our own rules: a perfectly valid transfer of authority, notarized and filed. We stamped it ourselves.

Effective line: The Hall of Final Approvals is at the top of the D.N.A. Go carefully. Or fill out a form. Ideally both.
Suggested line: The Hall of Final Approvals is at the top of the D.N.A., and whoever sits in it holds the authorization. Go carefully, or fill out a form first. Ideally both.

Effective line: Not yet, then. Take a number. It is still zero.
Suggested line: Not yet, then. You may take another number, though it will also be zero.

Effective line: Urgent delivery. Signature required. Signature will be taken.
Suggested line: Urgent delivery! A signature is required, and if one is not given, one will be taken.

Effective line: Unpaid. Undead. Eager to impress the new management. At last, some hands-on experience.
Suggested line: Unpaid, undead and eager to impress the new management. At last, some hands-on experience!

Effective line: Has wanted a quick sync since 1994. Now enforces the new regulations with great, unenthusiastic precision.
Suggested line: He has wanted a quick sync with you since 1994. Now he enforces the new regulations with great, unenthusiastic precision.

Effective line: The machine screams. The coffee screams. You drink it anyway. -1 HP.
Suggested line: The machine screams, then the coffee screams, and you drink it anyway. -1 HP.

Effective line: A coin rolls out of the dispenser. The machine regrets nothing. +gold.
Suggested line: A coin rolls out of the dispenser instead of coffee, and the machine shows no remorse at all. +gold.

Effective line: You drink the coffee. Almost drinkable. Someone may be disciplined. (+HP)
Suggested line: The coffee is almost drinkable. Someone in the breakroom may be disciplined for this. (+HP)

Effective line: Perfect brew! The machine seems proud of itself. Full recovery of... something.
Suggested line: A perfect brew. The machine gives a proud little hum, and you feel fully restored.

Effective line: You sink into the Breakroom Couch. Somehow it is both ice cold and slightly damp. HP restored.
Suggested line: You sink into the Breakroom Couch, which is somehow both ice cold and slightly damp. HP restored.

Effective line: The suggestion box is empty now. The committee read your suggestion. It was not implemented. It was, however, laminated.
Suggested line: The suggestion box is empty. The committee read your suggestion and did not implement it, but they did laminate it.

Effective line: first clear! here's a bonus. been in my desk since '09. finally found the right occasion to open the drawer.
Suggested line: first clear! here's a bonus. it's been in my desk drawer since '09, waiting for the right occasion, and this is it.

Effective line: it's a memory game. literally. we're all memories here. anyway.
Suggested line: a memory game, in a building full of people who are mostly memories. i thought it was clever. Agnes didn't laugh.

Effective line: ok so: flip two cards at a time. find all 8 pairs in 14 moves or fewer. fewer moves, more stars. easy. ish.
Suggested line: so: flip two cards at a time and find all 8 pairs in 14 moves or fewer. fewer moves means more stars. easy-ish.

Effective line: out of moves. my virtual pet lasted an hour. want another go? you get a better deal than the pet.
Suggested line: out of moves. hey, you still lasted longer than my virtual pet does. want another go?

Effective line: nice flipping! top 8, number one. sorry, me. we had a good run.
Suggested line: nice flipping! you're number one in my top 8 now. sorry, me. we had a good run.

Effective line: Oh! A customer! Hello. Gerald, breakroom barista. Also Number 4,000,212. They're on 3. I brought a book. Several. All of them, actually.
Suggested line: Oh! A customer! Hello. I'm Gerald, the breakroom barista, and also Number 4,000,212. They're on 3, so I brought a book. Well, several. All of them, actually.

Effective line: I make coffee for people who can't taste it. Nobody ever sends a cup back. The machine in the corner is temperamental: half miracle, half a different kind of miracle.
Suggested line: I make coffee for people who can't taste it, so nobody ever sends a cup back. Mind the machine in the corner, though: it's half miracle and half a different kind of miracle.

Effective line: Per my last memo: still serving 3. Per the memo before that: also 3.
Suggested line: They're still on 3. I wrote a memo about it, and the memo before that said 3 as well. I'm keeping them all in a folder, for when it changes.

Effective line: Welcome to the Department of Necrotic Affairs, dear. Agnes Overdue, front desk. Deceased since 1987, employee of the month since 1987. Nobody else qualified.
Suggested line: Welcome to the Department of Necrotic Affairs, dear. I'm Agnes Overdue, front desk. I died at this desk in 1987 and I've been employee of the month ever since. Nobody else qualified.

Effective line: Take a number: yours is 4,000,213. We're serving 3. Ten years ago, {villain}'s people filed some paperwork, properly. Now the whole Department works for him.
Suggested line: Here's your number, dear: 4,000,213. We're serving 3. Ten years ago {villain}'s people filed some paperwork, and they filed it properly, and now the whole Department works for him.

Effective line: We all know it's wrong. But the authorization is valid. Irregular things I can fight, dear. Valid things just sit there and smile at you.
Suggested line: Every one of us knows it's wrong, but the authorization is valid. Irregular things I can fight, dear. Valid things just sit there and smile at you.

Effective line: Back again, dear? Nobody else leaves. Since the transfer, not one soul has passed on. Not even me.
Suggested line: Back again, dear? You're the only one who ever leaves. Since the transfer, not one soul in this building has passed on, and that includes me.

Effective line: The Records Basement elevator needs Form 13-B. I don't have one. Nobody does. I applied, but the application form is a 13-B.
Suggested line: The Records Basement elevator wants Form 13-B, and nobody has one. I applied for one, dear, but the application form is a 13-B.

Effective line: Ten years ago I stamped the royal funeral forms myself. The king. The queen.
Suggested line: Ten years ago I stamped the royal funeral forms myself, dear: one for the king and one for the queen. My hand shook on both of them.

Effective line: There was a third form, for the little prince. It was never filed. No remains, no certificate. Policy is very strict about that.
Suggested line: There was a third form, for the little prince, and I never filed it. No remains, no certificate. Policy is very strict about that, and for once I was glad of it.

Effective line: krrrshhh... beep-boop... sorry. dial-up greeting. forty seconds. around here, that counts as an outburst.
Suggested line: krrrshhh... beep-boop... sorry, that's my dial-up greeting. takes forty seconds. around here that counts as an outburst.

Effective line: i'm Kyle. deceased since '09. runner-up, employee of the month, 2009. Agnes won. Agnes always wins.
Suggested line: i'm Kyle, deceased since '09. i was runner-up for employee of the month in 2009, but Agnes won. Agnes always wins.

Effective line: fun fact: ten years ago i filed the big transfer form. didn't read it. who reads forms.
Suggested line: fun fact: ten years ago i was the one who filed the big transfer form. didn't read it, though. who reads forms?

Effective line: ...oh. right. Necrocrats. we read forms. that's, like, our whole thing.
Suggested line: ...oh. right. we're Necrocrats. reading forms is our whole thing. i think about that more than i let on.

Effective line: anyway. wanna play? flip two cards, match the pairs. i made the cards myself.
Suggested line: so, um. wanna play? you flip two cards and match the pairs. i made the cards myself.

Effective line: virtual pet died again. seven times this week. i'll hatch another. little egg, big commitment.
Suggested line: my virtual pet died again, seventh time this week. i'll hatch another one. little egg, big commitment.

Effective line: anyway. wanna play?
Suggested line: wanna play another round? i shuffled and everything.

Effective line: Requisitions. Clerk Ledgerbone. Junior clerk, third class, third time dying. Cards, in triplicate. All Necrocrat-issue: authorized, stamped, haunted.
Suggested line: Requisitions. I'm Clerk Ledgerbone, junior clerk, third class. Cards are issued in triplicate, and every one is Necrocrat-issue: authorized, stamped and slightly haunted.

Effective line: The stamp is haunted. It requested a raise. The new boss denied it. The stamp is taking this personally.
Suggested line: The stamp is haunted. It asked the new management for a raise and was denied, and it has taken that very personally.

Effective line: No returns. No exchanges. Exceptions require Form 13-B. You've heard about 13-B.
Suggested line: No returns and no exchanges. Exceptions require Form 13-B, which I gather you've heard about.

Effective line: Requisition something. Or stand near the desk. You make me look busy. Excellent work so far.
Suggested line: Requisition something, or just stand near the desk. You make me look busy, and that's excellent work so far.

Effective line: Ah. A candidate for re-certification. Director Ectomund, Compliance Examiner. I examine. It is all I do. It is all I am.
Suggested line: Ah, a candidate for re-certification. I am Director Ectomund, Compliance Examiner. Examining is all I do, and after three hundred years I suspect it is all I am.

Effective line: I have set the same exam for three hundred years. Four questions on the Necrocrats. Every answer is on the premises: signs, memos, the staff.
Suggested line: I have set the same exam for three hundred years: four questions on the Necrocrats. Every answer is somewhere on the premises, in the signs, the memos or the staff.

Effective line: The new management asked me to remove the questions on ethics. They are not in the exam. They are also, I notice, not in the building.
Suggested line: The new management asked me to remove the questions on ethics, so they are no longer in the exam. They are also, I notice, no longer in the building.

Effective line: Answer correctly and you will be rewarded. Answer incorrectly and you will be rewarded less. I am not a monster. I am an examiner.
Suggested line: Answer correctly and you will be rewarded. Answer incorrectly and you will be rewarded less. I am not a monster, merely an examiner.

Effective line: Director Ectomund's quiz, and one hidden stash in the filing mazes. The stashes are in the corners nobody visits. So: everywhere.
Suggested line: Pass Director Ectomund's quiz and find one hidden stash in the filing mazes. The stashes are tucked in corners nobody visits, which here is all of them.

Effective line: Audit closed. The auditors have gone home. They live here. They went to their desks.
Suggested line: Audit closed. The auditors have gone home, which for them means back to their desks.

Effective line: Compliance is auditing. Two things, from a fresh pair of hands. One: pass Director Ectomund's re-certification quiz. Two: find one hidden stash in the filing mazes.
Suggested line: Compliance is auditing, and I need a fresh pair of hands for two things. One: pass Director Ectomund's re-certification quiz. Two: find a hidden stash in the filing mazes.

Effective line: I cannot leave the desk. Policy. Also, my legs are on loan to Accounts. I await their return.
Suggested line: I can't leave the desk. Policy forbids it, and my legs are on loan to Accounts until further notice.

Effective line: The quiz, passed. A stash, found. Both boxes ticked, in ink. Oh. Oh, that's lovely.
Suggested line: The quiz is passed and a stash is found, so both boxes are ticked, in ink. Oh. Oh, that's lovely.

Effective line: Three roaming staff, dear, on any floor. Processed, not promoted. Don't confuse the two. I did once, and now he's my supervisor.
Suggested line: Three roaming staff, dear, on any floor. Processed, mind, not promoted. I confused the two once, and now he's my supervisor.

Effective line: The backlog is clear. It will be full again by Thursday. It's nice to have a moment, isn't it? I don't get many.
Suggested line: The backlog's clear, dear, and it'll be full again by Thursday. Still, it's nice to have a moment, isn't it? I don't get many.

Effective line: Agnes Overdue's backlog has gone feral and is wandering the floors. Process three roaming staff members. By duel. Per policy.
Suggested line: Agnes Overdue's backlog has gone feral and is wandering the floors. Process three roaming staff members: by duel, per policy.

Effective line: Oh good, a presence. I have a backlog, dear, and it's a literal one: three staff went feral over a deadline from the new management. They wander the floors.
Suggested line: Oh good, someone with a pulse. I have a backlog, dear, and this one walks: three staff went feral over a deadline from the new management, and now they wander the floors.

Effective line: Would you process three of them? Roaming staff, any floor, by duel. We can't hurt colleagues. You aren't one. You haven't filled out the form.
Suggested line: Would you process three of them for me, by duel, on any floor? We're not allowed to raise a hand to colleagues, and you aren't one, dear. You never filled out the form.

Effective line: Three! That clears the backlog. Do you know how many forms that closes? Neither do I. Here's your bonus, dear.
Suggested line: Three! That clears the backlog. I couldn't tell you how many forms that closes, dear; I stopped counting in 1987. Here's your bonus.

Effective line: The time clock by the front desk, then the coffee machine here in the breakroom. Either order. HR isn't picky. HR is just watching.
Suggested line: Punch in at the time clock by the front desk and pour a cup at the coffee machine here, in either order. HR isn't picky. HR is just watching.

Effective line: You're one of us now. Officially. Please don't read the contract. I read it once, and I'm still in line.
Suggested line: You're one of us now, officially. I wouldn't read the contract if I were you. I read it once, and I'm still in line.

Effective line: Gerald says every new hire must complete onboarding, starting at the time clock. HR will know. HR is in the walls.
Suggested line: Gerald says every new hire must complete onboarding, starting at the time clock, because HR will know. HR is in the walls.

Effective line: Do not skip it. HR is in the walls, and HR reports to him now. I try not to lean on the walls. It feels like sharing too much.
Suggested line: Please don't skip it. HR is in the walls, and these days HR reports to him. I try not to lean on the walls; it feels like oversharing.

Effective line: Punched in, caffeinated and compliant! Onboarding complete. Here's your welcome kit.
Suggested line: Punched in, caffeinated and compliant! That's onboarding done, so here's your welcome kit.

Effective line: The kit is a welcome. I said it very warmly. That was the kit.
Suggested line: The welcome is the main part of the kit, and I said it as warmly as I could. I've been practising it in the queue for years.

Effective line: Not a pass. Study the signs and come back; there is no limit on attempts. I will be here. I am always here.
Suggested line: That is not a pass. Study the signs and come back; there is no limit on attempts, and I will be here. I am always here.

Effective line: Zero. Impressive, in its own way. Nothing for you.
Suggested line: Zero. That is impressive in its own way, but it earns you nothing.

Effective line: One correct. Your token. I have noted your potential in the margin, in very small writing.
Suggested line: One correct, which earns you a token. I have noted your potential in the margin, in very small writing.

Effective line: Two. Half-credit. Half-credit is the highest honor of the Necrocrats.
Suggested line: Two. Half-credit, and half-credit is the highest honour a Necrocrat can hope for.

Effective line: Three correct. One shy of perfect. Take your reward; perfect would have made me suspicious.
Suggested line: Three correct, one shy of perfect. Take your reward; a perfect score would have made me suspicious.

Effective line: Four correct. Perfect. I have recorded my joy in triplicate. Please do not ask me to demonstrate it.
Suggested line: Four correct. Perfect! I have recorded my joy in triplicate, and I must ask you not to make me demonstrate it.

Effective line: The stamp has been used. The form is complete. Nothing else will be approved today, or any day.
Suggested line: The stamp has been used and the form is complete. Nothing else will be approved today, or any other day.

Effective line: Can't collect a soul in this building, dear. The paperwork won't let me past the lobby. I've been waiting since the transfer.
Suggested line: Lovely building. Can't collect a single soul in it, mind. The paperwork won't let me past the lobby, and I've been sat here since the transfer.

Effective line: I took a number. Heh. Makes a change. Usually I'm the one calling them.
Suggested line: I took a number, heh. Makes a change. Usually I'm the one calling them.

Effective line: Appointments. Let's see. You... hm. Not for a good long while. Ha! Lovely.
Suggested line: Appointments. Let's see, you're... hm. Not for a good long while. Ha! Lovely.

Effective line: The stamp wants a raise. I have given it the form. It is thinking.
Suggested line: The stamp wants a raise. I've given it the form, and it's thinking it over.

Effective line: Coffee? Nobody can taste it. I make it anyway. It's the thought.
Suggested line: Coffee? Nobody here can taste it, but I make it anyway. It's the thought.

Effective line: Appeal forty thousand and one. Denied. I'm starting to take it personally.
Suggested line: Appeal forty thousand and one, denied. I'm starting to take it personally, dear.

Effective line: Number 4,000,212? That's me. They're on 3. Can you help?
Suggested line: Number 4,000,212? That's me, and they're on 3. I don't suppose you could help?

Effective line: The queue in the Waiting Room of Eternity is stuck. Process two of the roaming staff on the D.N.A. floors and I'll get you in. I've brought a book. Several.
Suggested line: The queue for the Waiting Room of Eternity is stuck. If you process two of the roaming staff on the D.N.A. floors, I can get you in. I'll wait. I'm very good at it.

Effective line: Process two roaming staff on the D.N.A. floors. The queue will not move itself. I've given it a very fair chance.
Suggested line: Two roaming staff on the D.N.A. floors, if you can. The queue won't move itself; I've given it a very fair chance.

Effective line: Two fewer. The queue moved! Slightly. I felt it in my ticket.
Suggested line: Two fewer, and the queue moved! Only slightly, but I felt it in my ticket.

Effective line: The Waiting Room of Eternity will see you now. Take a number. Please leave mine; we've been through so much together.
Suggested line: The Waiting Room of Eternity will see you now. Do take a number, just not mine. We've been through so much together.

Effective line: I'm on lunch. Nothing happens on lunch. That includes me.
Suggested line: I'm on lunch, and nothing happens on lunch. That includes me.
